slides.title: Small steps. Real progress.
slides.label: PRESENTATION TEMPLATE
slides.html:
Small steps.
Real progress.

Your name · Your event
slides.purpose: 一句话建立主题；不重复主持人的介绍。

notes.cue: 演讲 3 分钟，问答 2 分钟。主持人介绍结束后开始；黄色提示不读。

notes.say: Today I want to share a simple way to turn an idea into something we can test.

notes.cue: 按 ↓ 进入正文；准备开始时按 T 计时。

slides.title: Start with one question
slides.label: ONE IDEA PER SCREEN
slides.html:
What do we need
to learn next?

Choose one thing you can test.
slides.purpose: 先说明听众为什么需要关心，再进入例子。

notes.say: A small test can help us learn before we make a bigger choice. We do not need to answer every question at once.

notes.cue: 停顿；这是陈述，不要求观众回答。

notes.say: Start with the one question that matters most. Then make something small enough to test.

slides.title: Build. Try. Improve.
slides.label: SHOW THE PROCESS
slides.html:
Build small.
Learn sooner.

Feedback changes the next version.
slides.purpose: 用可见的返回箭头解释循环；不只把三个词摆成一排。

notes.say: Make a first version. Let someone try it. Use what you learn to make it better.

notes.cue: 先讲正向三步，再指返回箭头。

notes.say: The first version does not need to answer everything. It needs to help you decide what to do next.

notes.cue: 这一页正文不长；预算不是需要填满的时长。

notes.say: Thank you. I am happy to take your questions.

notes.cue: 问答开始；这里不再添加新论点。
